paragraphs: Rav Sheizvi. His father—or father-in-law, Rashi—regularly kindled many lamps. Rav Hisda said that a great man would issue from him: Shabbat 23b. In R' Elazar ben Azarya's name: Pesahim 118a; Avodah Zarah 19a; Eruvin 54b. He transmitted in Rav Huna’s name: Bekhorot 11a. He transmitted in Rav Hisda’s name: Shabbat 136b; Eruvin 80b; Yevamot 83b. He transmitted in R' Yohanan’s name: Yoma 81a. He spoke to R' Yosi bar Anin: Zevahim 69b. Rav Yeimar was his son [one reading in Berakhot 53b calls him Rav Yeimar bar Sheizvi]. He transmitted in Rav Nahman’s name: Eruvin 77a. He spoke to Rava: Keritot 4b. Rava said, ‘A great man has said something; do not laugh at him’: Gittin 55b. Rava said, ‘Rav Sheizvi misled Rav Hisda, who expounded’: Shabbat 120a. He asked Rabbah: Bava Kamma 51b.
